nodes.description: Constant total supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens (18 decimals) minted at construction
Role identifier required to authorize burning of tokens
ERC20 mapping of account balances
ERC20 total supply counter
AccessControl mapping of role data to role members and admin role
EIP712 domain separator used for typed message hashing
Monotonically increasing counter of the latest snapshot id
WasderToken constructor: mints initial supply, initializes EIP712 domain and grants admin role
External burn function restricted to BURNER_ROLE holders
External snapshot trigger restricted to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders
ERC677 transfer that executes an external callback on the recipient contract
Private helper using extcodesize to detect whether an address is a contract
Internal ERC20 burn logic that decreases balance and total supply
Internal ERC20 mint logic that increases total supply and credits balance
Internal role assignment bypassing caller authorization checks
Public role grant function guarded by the role admin check
Context helper returning msg.sender
IERC677Receiver callback invoked on the recipient contract during token transfer
Caller address, attacker controllable, used for role checks and forwarded to external calls
External call to IERC677Receiver.onTokenTransfer on an untrusted recipient contract
Inline assembly extcodesize used to detect contract code
Parameter amount of the burn function
Recipient address parameter of transferAndCall
Amount parameter of transferAndCall
Arbitrary calldata parameter forwarded to the receiver callback
Address parameter inspected by isContract
Constructor recipient address for the initial mint and admin role
Role identifier parameter of grantRole
Account parameter of grantRole
Local variable storing the extcodesize result in isContract

edges.reason: burn invokes the internal _burn routine
amount parameter flows into burn and _burn
msg.sender is checked against BURNER_ROLE inside burn
BURNER_ROLE constant gates the burn function via hasRole
msg.sender is checked against DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE inside snapshot
snapshot increments and reads _currentSnapshotId
constructor mints the initial supply
INITIAL_SUPPLY is used in the constructor mint
constructor recipient parameter to receives the initial supply
constructor assigns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE via _setupRole
constructor initializes the EIP712 domainSeperator
_mint increases _totalSupply
_mint credits the recipient in _balances
_burn debits the account in _balances
_burn reduces _totalSupply
msg.sender is forwarded and emitted by transferAndCall
_to parameter is used by transferAndCall for transfer and contract check
_value parameter is used by transferAndCall
_data parameter is used by transferAndCall and emitted
transferAndCall performs an external callback before returning, allowing reentrancy on the token state
transferAndCall calls isContract to detect the recipient code
_to flows into isContract address check
_addr parameter is inspected by isContract
isContract uses inline assembly extcodesize
external call invokes the untrusted IERC677Receiver.onTokenTransfer callback on the recipient
_value is forwarded into the external onTokenTransfer call
_data is forwarded into the external onTokenTransfer call
msg.sender is forwarded as _sender to the receiver callback
grantRole verifies msg.sender holds the role admin
grantRole delegates to _setupRole
role parameter is used by grantRole
account parameter is used by grantRole
grantRole reads the _roles mapping for authorization
_msgSender returns msg.sender
burn obtains the caller through _msgSender for its role check
length local variable holds the extcodesize result inside isContract

normalization_plan.reason: amount is only the burn function parameter and has no standalone semantic meaning outside burn
_to is only the recipient parameter consumed by transferAndCall and its isContract check
_value is only the transfer amount parameter consumed by transferAndCall and forwarded to the callback
_data is only the extra calldata parameter consumed and forwarded by transferAndCall
_addr is only the parameter inspected by the isContract extcodesize check
to is only the constructor recipient used for the initial mint and admin role setup
role is only the role identifier parameter consumed by grantRole
account is only the grantee parameter consumed by grantRole
length is a local temporary that only carries the extcodesize result inside isContract
